import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/room-churn-reuse-candidate.json').read_text())
servers = {'before': root / meta['baseline_path'], 'selected': root / meta['directory'] / 'war-relay'}
client = root / meta['helper']['directory'] / 'inspection'
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
output = root / 'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-room-churn-memory.json'
record = {'scope': 'Four isolated two-second one-worker allocator diagnostics, not ordinary timings. gperftools replaces only the server allocator.512 stable readers,1-message windows, no private traffic or inspection. Churn joins/retires one temporary reader each window; complete window,Close/EOF and every survivor departure finish each cycle. Sent messages equal completed membership cycles, so each cycle has identical structural work; full bytes and independent counters still verified. Stable guard has no membership changes. Requested live/cumulative allocation sizes/counts, not RSS. Cumulative phase deltas include fixed HTTP gate/dump overhead, amortized by completed cycles or broadcasts. All heap captures and source hashes retained.',
          'candidate': meta, 'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'cases': [], 'captures': [], 'passed': False}
for mode, every in [('stable', 0), ('churn', 1)]:
    for role in servers:
        trace = output.with_name(f'2026-10-16-room-churn-heap-{mode}-{role}.json')
        heap = root / f'artifacts/room-churn-heap/{mode}-{role}'
        command = [sys.executable, str(root / 'scripts/inspection.py'), '--server', str(servers[role]), '--client', str(client),
                   '--rooms', '0', '--pairs', '0', '--mode', 'none', '--inspectors', '0', '--churn-workers', '0',
                   '--fanout-readers', '512', '--fanout-window', '1', '--fanout-churn-every', str(every),
                   '--seconds', '2', '--workers', '1', '--heap-profile', str(heap), '--output', str(trace)]
        done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
        data = json.loads(trace.read_text()); assert done.returncode == 0 and data['passed'] and data['profile_diagnostic'], done.stdout + done.stderr
        phases = {}
        for event in data['events']:
            h = event['heap']; path = Path(h['path']); assert sha(path) == h['sha256']
            match = re.match(r'heap profile:\s+(\d+):\s+(\d+)\s+\[\s*(\d+):\s*(\d+)\]', h['header']); assert match
            phases[event['event']] = dict(zip(['live_objects', 'live_bytes', 'allocated_objects', 'allocated_bytes'], map(int, match.groups())))
            record['captures'].append({'mode': mode, 'kind': role, 'event': event['event'], 'path': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': h['sha256'], 'header': h['header']})
        m = data['mixed']; cycles = m['fanout_membership']['verified'] if every else data['events'][1]['details']['counts']['sent_messages']
        if every:
            counts = data['events'][1]['details']['counts']
            assert counts['sent_messages'] == cycles
            assert counts['normal_closes'] == cycles and counts['joins'] == 513 + cycles
        row = {'mode': mode, 'kind': role, 'trace': str(trace.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(trace), 'phases': phases,
               'work_units': cycles, 'allocation_delta': {key: phases['measured'][key] - phases['ready'][key] for key in ['allocated_objects', 'allocated_bytes']}}
        row['allocation_per_work_unit'] = {key: value / cycles for key, value in row['allocation_delta'].items()}
        record['cases'].append(row); output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n'); print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
record['passed'] = True
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
